rules: Do not truncate, compact, or drop portal packet units.
Require a substantive, sourced, role-linked company introduction; concise wording must not collapse it to a company-name and industry label.
Use all available permanent JobKorea field capacity for whole substantive JD units before leaving those units only in transient proposalMessage.
Record required characters, remaining permanent-field characters, move feasibility, and final reason for every JobKorea proposalMessage unit.
Generate Gmail as an uncapped standalone candidate JD and LinkedIn RPS under the 1900-character internal authoring limit counted as subject plus blank line plus body.
Raw JD facts excluded from candidate copy by explicit or standing user instruction must be represented in excluded_units with reason starting explicit_user_exclusion or standing_user_exclusion.
Do not include generic documents/application boilerplate or obvious conditions when the user explicitly or standingly excludes them; preserve them only as excluded_units evidence.
Assign each source unit id exactly once per portal packet.
Refuse URL, email, and direct-apply text in candidate-visible fields.
JobKorea proposalMessage is transient until read back from a proposal flow.
Map every original source item to a freshly reopened field or explicit exclusion; packet-unit coverage alone is insufficient.
Never append excluded raw source to any owner-email body, including an original-source preservation appendix.
Inspect actual Saramin edit and preview sections before changing fields; never treat title as body.
Exclude process-stage addition/omission paraphrases and the entire designated application/footer tail from portal and email copy.
